profile.headline: Software Engineer @ ThermoFisher Scientific
profile.summary:
I aim to bridges the gap between functionality and aesthetics, crafting seamless and intuitive digital experiences. With experience in both software development and user experience and interface design, I hope to brings a unique perspective to building scalable, efficient, and user-friendly applications -- whether optimizing code or user flows. 
Check out my portfolio here ➡️http://yingxilong.com
And my Github here ➡️ https://github.com/LongAli

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Build and maintain design system with scalable, robust and reusable components and document using Storybook to improve design-to-production efficiency
• Collaborate with tech leads and lab technicians on improvement features and functional bugs using Angular and Java
• Refractor major components to support complex use cases (e.g. customized sorting and filtering for grid) and perform unit tests
• Prototype and iterate 10+ workflow based on design principles, stakeholder feedback and technical constraints

positions.title: UX Designer
positions.description:
• Work with UX Designer, UI Designer and Product Design Lead to define the component design process in the library and write up detailed documentation
• Ship the first version of Pangea’s design system, Panthalassa to improve design and engineering communication

positions.title: Product Design Chair
positions.description:
• Provide mentorship for 10+ product designers and hold weekly workshops on design thinking, design process, and UI design principles.
 • Work closely with developers, data scientists, business development to incubate ~10 projects per quarter.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Diabetes Design initiative
• Under the mentorship of 4 designers and 1 doctor, I led a team of 4 to perform user research and develop an interactive tool for Type 1 Diabetes education

positions.title: UX Designer
positions.description:
Collaboration of Dexcom & Diabetes Design Initiative(DDI) 
• Tackle the problem concerning diabetes users of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems for a better shopping experience under the mentorship of industry
 • Conduct users to research on Canadian users and design a thorough Hi-fidelity prototype in 10 one-week sprints with a team of 4

educations.fieldOfStudy: Cognitive Science w/Spec Design and Interaction
